channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Roy Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Roy Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Green on Roy Williams
item.description:
“Coach Williams had us working with the Special Olympics and doing Christmas shopping for those less fortunate,”

Danny Green on Roy Williams, Mar 23, 2021. Source: University of North Carolina Athletic Site.

item.title: Ty Lawson on Roy Williams
item.description:
Lawson continued in a second post.

“They ask me why I don't show love to North Carolina ... Roy Williams knows why.”

Ty Lawson on Roy Williams, May 25, 2020. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Danny Green on Roy Williams
item.description:
“It shouldn't. I got my degree. I earned my degree. I'm proud of it. I know everybody was there with me in my classes. We worked. I did everything the right way. Coach Williams did everything the right way.”

Danny Green on Roy Williams, Jun 7, 2014. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.
